# NeelStack Solutions — Complete Context & Documentation

> NeelStack Solutions Private Limited is an AI-native technology and software engineering company incorporated in Uttar Pradesh, India (CIN: U62011UP2026PTC250857). We build proprietary software products, engineer custom business applications, modernise legacy systems, and deliver specialised AI and software engineering capabilities through flexible delivery teams.

### Workforce Delivery Model Transparency
NeelStack delivers engineering solutions through a transparent, high-integrity hybrid model: direct core architects and engineers, supplemented by screened, contractually-engaged senior engineers and approved delivery partners under strict IP assignment, non-disclosure (NDA), and client confidentiality agreements.

## 2. Division 1: Proprietary Software Products

### DhruvaOS (Flagship AI-Native School Operating System)
- Target: Schools, K-12 Academies, Colleges, Universities, and Educational Trusts
- Launch Timeline: Beta Live with early pilot institutions · Full Public Launch November 14, 2026
- Scope: School administration, online admissions, automated fee reconciliation, RFID & biometric campus attendance, academics & examinations, parent/student portals, mobile & desktop applications, and institutional analytics.
- URL: https://neelstack.com/products/dhruvaos (Dedicated portal: https://dhruvaos.com)

### ToolVines (Browser-Native Developer Platform)
- Target: Software engineers, DevOps architects, technical writers, and knowledge workers
- Status: Live Product in Production (https://toolvines.com)
- Scope: Suite of client-side developer utilities, cryptography tools, PDF formatters, and media transcoders executing 100% in-browser via Rust WebAssembly with zero remote document storage.
- URL: https://neelstack.com/products/toolvines

## 3. Division 2: Enterprise Software & AI Engineering Services

- Custom Software Development: Bespoke business applications, ERP systems, internal workflow engines, and B2B portals.
- AI Application & Agent Development: Frontier LLM integrations (Claude 3.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5/2.0), LangGraph cyclic agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool execution, and GraphRAG knowledge search.
- Legacy System Modernization: Deconstructing brittle monolithic architectures into scalable microservices and APIs using strangler-fig patterns, dual-write database synchronization, automated regression harnesses, and rollback safeguards.
- Cloud Architecture & DevOps: Resilient multi-AZ cloud deployments on AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker containerization, Kubernetes clustering, Terraform infrastructure-as-code, and compute optimization.
- Modern Web & Mobile Applications: High-performance Next.js 16 web applications, sub-second API backends, and cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications.

## 4. Division 3: Specialist Engineering & AI Workforce

- Contract Software Developers: Individual senior engineers across Next.js/React, Python FastAPI, Java, and Cloud DevOps for staff augmentation.
- Dedicated Engineering Pods: Managed cross-functional squads (3–8 specialists) governed by agile sprint retainers with 100% client code ownership upon milestone delivery.
- AI Model Evaluation: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) evaluation, RLHF preference ranking, prompt-response accuracy benchmarking, and hallucination reduction.
- AI Data Annotation & QA: Multilingual Indian vernacular validation, code review benchmarking, and domain data curation.
- Vendor Partnerships: Structured subcontracting and delivery partnerships for global IT system integrators and technology consulting firms (https://neelstack.com/partnerships).
